title: Risk-Tiered Action Gating: Empirically Calibrating When Human-in-the-Loop Is Worth Its Cost
original_idea: Build taxonomy of agentic action types. Construct 200 synthetic agent trajectories. Have human raters score reversibility and harm. Train logistic regression gate classifier on action metadata. Evaluate precision/recall.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Practical contribution to agent oversight, but logistic regression on synthetic data may not generalize to real deployments. Moderate impact.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires designing taxonomy, creating 200 synthetic trajectories, coordinating human raters, training classifier. Coordination-heavy but technically simple.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Taxonomy design, dataset creation, human rating coordination, classifier training and evaluation. Multiple sequential dependencies.
